summary: A high-quality ZnO epilayer was grown on the (0001) sapphire substrate by atomic layer deposition (ALD) at a low deposition temperature of 180 °C, followed by high-temperature rapid thermal annealing (RTA). The layer-by-layer growth and low deposition temperature of ALD, as well as the RTA treatment, prevent the formation of columnar structures in the ZnO epilayer. The resulting ZnO film exhibited optically-pumped stimulated emission with a low-threshold intensity of 153 kW/cm² at room temperature.
evidence: A high-quality ZnO epilayer was grown on the (0001) sapphire substrate by atomic layer deposition (ALD) and followed by high-temperature rapid thermal annealing (RTA).
